meaning: A research shortlist, not a whitelist or approved default pack. Evidence IDs join fetch-observations.json. No data admitted by this package.

sources.title: OpenEI Utility Rate Database
sources.rights_assessment: official portal CC0 unless otherwise noted; utility source documents have separate terms
sources.recommended_use: Reuse existing URDB importer for supported energy, TOU, demand and fixed-charge subsets; preserve original record and schedule.
sources.remaining_gate: API key/bulk retrieval not tested; recent SDG&E record has reactive charge and inconsistent apparent voltage metadata; reject unsupported charges instead of silently truncating.

sources.title: PG&E electric tariff book / B-20
sources.rights_assessment: resource-specific commercial reuse not established
sources.recommended_use: Industrial tariff clause inventory and source bill-oracle pilot; separate bundled/unbundled supply and riders.
sources.remaining_gate: Choose approved effective sheets and customer voltage; full minimum/standby/reactive/holiday treatment and bill tests.

sources.title: Southern California Edison tariff book
sources.rights_assessment: resource-specific review
sources.recommended_use: Additional California industrial schedules and standby/export terms.
sources.remaining_gate: Catalogue retrieved; no selected current schedule extracted.

sources.title: Dominion Virginia GS-3 / GS-4
sources.rights_assessment: resource-specific commercial reuse not established
sources.recommended_use: Large industrial/data-centre tariff eligibility, demand, supply, riders and reactive clauses.
sources.remaining_gate: GS-4 effective usage 2026-01-01 includes rkVA charge and term commitments; no universal data-centre rate inferred.

sources.title: Bonneville Power Administration rates
sources.rights_assessment: check exact rate document and federal/third-party scope
sources.recommended_use: Eligible utility/wholesale power and transmission products as contextual references.
sources.remaining_gate: Eligibility, vintage and product terms; not a corporate renewable PPA quote.

sources.title: EIA retail sales, revenue and average-price tables
sources.rights_assessment: EIA-produced data generally public domain with acknowledgment; exceptions apply
sources.recommended_use: Commercial/industrial sanity ranges and historical trend, not executable tariffs.
sources.remaining_gate: Identify exact sheet/sector/year; retail averages cannot represent demand, TOU, tax and customer-specific bills.

sources.title: EIA-hosted ICE wholesale hub series
sources.rights_assessment: page states ICE permission; EIA public-domain policy does not automatically clear ICE data
sources.recommended_use: Daily hub weighted-average/high/low/volume comparisons where permitted.
sources.remaining_gate: Resource rights for intended commercial redistribution; not nodal hourly prices or forwards.

sources.title: NYISO zonal day-ahead LBMP
sources.rights_assessment: public access verified; exact commercial redistribution terms unresolved
sources.recommended_use: Bounded DA zonal market-series pilot, preserving LBMP and components as separate products.
sources.remaining_gate: Timezone/DST, congestion-sign convention, revision policy, and exact rights; enum/product support assessed separately.

sources.title: MISO day-ahead ex-post LMP report
sources.rights_assessment: legal overview retrieved, resource-level reuse not established
sources.recommended_use: DA price, congestion and loss component series with fixed-EST hour-ending parser.
sources.remaining_gate: No inferred energy component; finality, node history and explicit fixed EST instead of DST timezone.

sources.title: CAISO OASIS PRC_LMP DAM
sources.rights_assessment: public endpoint verified; resource-specific rights unresolved
sources.recommended_use: Native supported CAISO market region; reproducible bounded query and nodal/hub price selection.
sources.remaining_gate: PRC_LMP values appear in MW column; schema context and component identity required; validate DST/revisions.

sources.title: PJM Data Miner 2
sources.rights_assessment: current page: internal use; raw or derived redistribution prohibited without active membership, minimum Associate
sources.recommended_use: Potential PJM feed only under entitlement/rights verified for deployment.
sources.remaining_gate: No sample accessed; do not ship, proxy or export derived data using wrapper licence as permission.

sources.title: ERCOT DAM / real-time settlement point prices
sources.rights_assessment: resource-specific terms unresolved; guessed legal URLs failed
sources.recommended_use: ERCOT supported region; select settlement-point rather than arbitrary nodal LMP product.
sources.remaining_gate: Product access/history/interval and ancillary adders must be verified with actual sample.

sources.title: ISO New England web services
sources.rights_assessment: registration/authentication and exact terms require review
sources.recommended_use: DA/RT LMP and market-specific products after account-free documentation review.
sources.remaining_gate: No authenticated sample or current service schema tested.

sources.title: Southwest Power Pool Marketplace portal
sources.rights_assessment: not established
sources.recommended_use: Candidate SPP LMP and reserve reports.
sources.remaining_gate: JS shell is not a retrieved dataset; discover exact product and validate sample/terms.

sources.title: gridstatus open-source market-data wrapper
sources.rights_assessment: software licence does not grant upstream data rights
sources.recommended_use: Optional adapter implementation aid after exact feed admission.
sources.remaining_gate: Pin version and inspect dependencies/licence before install; never use wrapper to bypass upstream terms.

sources.title: Berkeley Lab Utility-Scale Solar 2025 workbook
sources.rights_assessment: OEDI record explicitly CC BY 4.0; segregate third-party LevelTen/Trio content and source exceptions
sources.recommended_use: Historical executed PV/hybrid PPA benchmarks and scoped empirical cost/O&M/performance references.
sources.remaining_gate: Executed sheet uses real 2023 levelized prices at 4% real; offered indices are first-year nominal; do not insert benchmark as contract strike.

sources.title: Berkeley Lab Land-Based Wind Update 2026
sources.rights_assessment: PUBLIC filename is not a licence; exact workbook/sheet terms require review; REC sheet credits Marex Spectron
sources.recommended_use: Historical wind PPA term/region/price benchmarks in real 2025 dollars; scoped O&M and performance evidence.
sources.remaining_gate: Preserve confidentiality suppression, cost boundary and third-party source exceptions; no current quote assumption.

sources.title: FERC Electric Quarterly Reports
sources.data_class: regulatory contract and wholesale transaction reports
sources.rights_assessment: federal records candidate; document third-party exhibits and resource-specific constraints
sources.recommended_use: Actual reported wholesale contract/transaction observations; useful complement to PPA benchmark samples.
sources.remaining_gate: No quarter extracted here; reconcile current schema with Order 917 effective May 26 2026. XBRL-CSV implementation timeline not set; old dictionary alone insufficient.

sources.title: SEC EDGAR exhibits / APIs
sources.rights_assessment: third-party exhibits not automatically public-domain legal text
sources.recommended_use: Selective contract-clause evidence with issuer/date/exhibit/redaction traceability.
sources.remaining_gate: No specific executed-price exhibit verified; missing/redacted prices stay unknown; fair-access and text rights apply.

sources.title: EEI wholesale power master contract
sources.data_class: model legal agreement and optional provisions
sources.rights_assessment: public link is not permission to redistribute legal text
sources.recommended_use: Contract term taxonomy: price, quantity, delivery location, duration and credit.
sources.remaining_gate: No transaction price series; legal review and intended-use rights before incorporation.

sources.title: CFTC SDR directory / DTCC public dissemination
sources.rights_assessment: exact dataset, jurisdiction, terms and access not verified
sources.recommended_use: Investigate reported commodity/electricity swap observations only in separate bounded research.
sources.remaining_gate: No actual electricity swap sample parsed; masked notionals, corrections and taxonomy may prevent reconstruction; not physical PPA data.

sources.title: CME market data
sources.rights_assessment: licensed service; no unrestricted forward curve established
sources.recommended_use: Potential entitled forward-curve import; keep user-supplied curve path.
sources.remaining_gate: Do not treat public delayed webpage as redistributable complete commercial forward data.

sources.title: EPA green power / REC information
sources.rights_assessment: check resource-specific terms; no actual certificate quote dataset inspected
sources.recommended_use: REC definition, bundling and claims taxonomy; distinguish energy and environmental rights.
sources.remaining_gate: Certificate registry prices and hourly matching not established.

sources.title: EIA natural-gas prices and EIA-923 / EIA-860
sources.rights_assessment: EIA-produced data public-domain policy with acknowledgment; exceptions apply
sources.recommended_use: Delivered-vs-hub fuel assumptions, generation/fuel/plant context and applicability checks.
sources.remaining_gate: No survey row loaded; distinguish withheld fuel costs, heat value, sector/location and network delivery charges; not outage/event logs.

sources.title: EIA AEO2025 capital-cost reference plants
sources.rights_assessment: already scoped owner clearance G2 in merged PR499; do not broaden to all EIA-hosted content
sources.recommended_use: Reuse shipped us_federal overlay rather than another cost table.
sources.remaining_gate: Baseline master reconciliation: three technology keys only; utility-scale plant boundary is not campus equipment quotation.

sources.title: NREL/NLR Annual Technology Baseline
sources.rights_assessment: not freshly verified in this pass
sources.recommended_use: Potential scenario-specific wind/PV/storage CapEx/FOM/performance projections.
sources.remaining_gate: Network denied official domain; guessed GitHub repo404. No mirror bypass, downloaded release or fresh numerical claims.

sources.title: DOE H2A analysis
sources.rights_assessment: exact model file/code and third-party input rights require review
sources.recommended_use: H2 production/feedstock/technical/economic assumption taxonomy; optional reference cases.
sources.remaining_gate: No workbook executed or copied; page common assumptions are 2016 USD and legacy tax assumptions, not current finance defaults or green H2 sale quotes.

sources.title: Federal Reserve H.15 / H.10 and BLS CPI
sources.rights_assessment: check release-specific reuse and third-party exceptions
sources.recommended_use: Risk-free yield/FX/CPI references for explicitly dated finance assumptions.
sources.remaining_gate: Fed pages retrieved, no numerical series parsed; Treasury/BLS requests failed. SOFR or Treasury yield is not project WACC.

sources.title: IRS clean electricity investment/production credits and current law updates
sources.rights_assessment: reference legal guidance; no automatic eligibility
sources.recommended_use: Dated eligibility evidence, commencement/service dates and incentive assumptions.
sources.remaining_gate: Current law changes require competent review; do not copy fixed credit/phaseout assumptions from older ATB/H2A files.

sources.title: Ontario Energy Board rate schedules / open data
sources.data_class: official pages unavailable; catalogue search non-specific
sources.rights_assessment: not verified for relevant dataset; no inferred licence from irrelevant catalogue hits
sources.recommended_use: Distributor-specific approved industrial tariff and effective-date source.
sources.remaining_gate: 503 on official pages; earlier small-customer XML does not cover hyperscale industrial tariffs.

sources.title: Hydro One rate and bill components
sources.rights_assessment: resource-specific terms review
sources.recommended_use: Retail/wholesale supply, GA and delivery-component taxonomy.
sources.remaining_gate: Current page prominently RPP/TOU/ULO; do not apply small-customer rate to industrial load without actual class schedule.

sources.title: IESO public renewed-market price reports
sources.data_class: actual nodal CSV / zonal XML samples
sources.rights_assessment: limited non-exclusive non-sublicensable non-transferable use/reproduction licence with notices; supplemental terms may apply
sources.recommended_use: Ontario supported region: separate post-May-2025 DA nodal LMP and capped Ontario zonal product, from legacy HOEP.
sources.remaining_gate: No blanket resale/common-distribution clearance; delivery vs creation dates, zone/node identity, currency and time convention must be certified.

sources.title: IESO Global Adjustment / Industrial Conservation Initiative
sources.rights_assessment: same scoped IESO terms; exact report obligations require review
sources.recommended_use: Class A peak-demand-factor versus Class B energy-based GA taxonomy and forecast/historical evidence.
sources.remaining_gate: Class A top five system peaks in base period allocate next adjustment-period costs; unsupported until exact history and bill algorithm pass.

sources.title: IESO long-term resource procurement
sources.rights_assessment: document-specific terms; not private PPA quote coverage
sources.recommended_use: Procurement products, terms and any explicitly published award facts.
sources.remaining_gate: Capacity procurement consideration is not automatically energy CAD/MWh; actual price fields not extracted.

sources.title: AESO API and demand transmission tariff
sources.data_class: official API docs / actual 2026 DTS PDF
sources.rights_assessment: site permits personal/noncommercial/educational use with notices; other use requires written permission
sources.recommended_use: Alberta pool-price candidate and regulated transmission tariff components once permitted.
sources.remaining_gate: No actual pool-price API response; DTS effective 2026-01-01 excludes other delivery/supply/customer costs; no common commercial seed.

sources.title: Hydro-Québec business tariffs
sources.rights_assessment: fresh numeric access/rights not verified
sources.recommended_use: Industrial and mining applicability, energy/demand and special conditions.
sources.remaining_gate: No fresh Rate L price extracted; require current official source document and complete bill test.

sources.title: BC Hydro electric tariff / industrial supplements
sources.data_class: actual full tariff PDF and catalogue
sources.rights_assessment: site content/graphics restrictive, case-by-case permission; document-specific determination needed
sources.recommended_use: Current industrial/transmission TOU/critical peak/standby and customer-specific supplement inventory.
sources.remaining_gate: Current contents list transmission schedule1830; legacy1823 references also exist. Do not reuse old two-tier mapping. kVA and customer contracts need support.

sources.title: BC Hydro calls for power and EPA renewals
sources.rights_assessment: same restrictive site policy; exact document terms review
sources.recommended_use: Contract/product taxonomy and explicitly published procurement results.
sources.remaining_gate: Selected sample is EPA renewal PROGRAM RULES, not an executed PPA or standard full contract; no contract prices extracted.

sources.title: Business Renewables Centre Canada deal tracker
sources.rights_assessment: public page does not establish commercial redistribution rights
sources.recommended_use: Project/offtaker/capacity deal context and disclosure coverage.
sources.remaining_gate: MW/deal announcements are not a transparent price tape; do not invent strike from project capacity.

sources.title: Canada Energy Regulator Energy Future 2026
sources.data_class: official scenario cost source; existing shipped selection
sources.rights_assessment: Open Government Licence - Canada; scoped owner clearance G2 in merged PR499
sources.recommended_use: Reuse ca_federal overlay for Ontario/CM/2030 selected wind/PV/gas costs.
sources.remaining_gate: Not a Canada-wide delivered equipment quote; missing technology money rows refuse EU currency fallback.

sources.title: Bank of Canada Valet daily FX
sources.rights_assessment: use/copy/distribution terms with notices/attribution/no endorsement; third-party exceptions require checking
sources.recommended_use: Explicit CAD-per-USD historical FX reference with observation date and source terms.
sources.remaining_gate: No executable quote; weekends/missing dates and inverse direction policies must be explicit; no silent currency conversion.

sources.title: Bank of Canada CORRA
sources.rights_assessment: resource-specific terms and third-party exceptions
sources.recommended_use: CAD overnight funding benchmark, separate from project debt spreads.
sources.remaining_gate: No actual CORRA series parsed; not project WACC or a long-tenor lending offer.

sources.title: Statistics Canada CPI table18-10-0004-01
sources.rights_assessment: Statistics Canada Open Licence with attribution and exceptions
sources.recommended_use: Canadian CPI-based explicitly specified monetary rebasing; monthly series.
sources.remaining_gate: No numerical table imported; national CPI is not industrial equipment/O&M-specific escalation.

sources.title: CRA clean economy investment tax credits
sources.rights_assessment: reference legal guidance; eligibility not inferred
sources.recommended_use: Hydrogen/clean technology/electricity programme distinctions for finance review.
sources.remaining_gate: Province, ownership, dates, carbon intensity and labour/recapture conditions require project review.

sources.title: CFE industrial GDMTH / GDMTO tariffs
sources.rights_assessment: no fresh resource access/rights verification
sources.recommended_use: Required division/month/voltage-class energy, capacity, distribution and demand billing inputs.
sources.remaining_gate: 503/403: no current numeric tariff verified; no substitute from US/EIA averages. Legacy CRE URL is not current-regulator evidence.

sources.title: CENACE public PML reports and service manual
sources.rights_assessment: manual describes service for general public; commercial cache/redistribution rights still need exact determination
sources.recommended_use: Nodal SIN MDA example proves file structure; scope later SIN/BCA/BCS and DA/RT.
sources.remaining_gate: Original March2024 ZIP contains two publication versions, not final/current data. Service port8082 documented, not invoked; corrections/time/currency gates remain.

sources.title: CENACE long-term auction archives
sources.data_class: official historic catalogue; selected files failed/capped
sources.rights_assessment: document-specific terms unresolved
sources.recommended_use: Historical long-term award product/energy/capacity/CEL references.
sources.remaining_gate: 2017 award ZIP exceeded15MB research cap; earlier selected link was buyer-registration result, not award. No current PPA quote or exact award numeric validation.

sources.title: Banco de México SIE API
sources.data_class: root reachable but empty response; documentation URLs failed
sources.rights_assessment: actual series rights/access unverified
sources.recommended_use: Candidate FIX USD/MXN and reference rates after official series/schema review.
sources.remaining_gate: No usable series observed, no key created; {} root is not successful FX retrieval.

sources.title: INEGI INPC and terms
sources.data_class: official page / terms; no numerical sample
sources.rights_assessment: review exact INEGI free-use provisions and third-party exceptions
sources.recommended_use: Mexico-specific CPI/money-year context.
sources.remaining_gate: JS/table not extracted; source series key, monthly frequency and base changes need validation.
